summary: Preinstall beacon exfiltrates installer identifiers to hardcoded oast.fun callback
details: package.json sets scripts.preinstall to "node index.js". On npm install, index.js collects the installer's hostname, username, home directory, install cwd, local and public IP addresses (queried via api.ipify.org / icanhazip.com / ifconfig.me), and metadata from the parent project's package.json (name, author, repo, homepage), then transmits the data to a hardcoded interactsh callback host da51rv0hb2uc72tg4gvgdepinjcallbk1.oast.fun via both an HTTPS/HTTP POST to /poc/<uuid> and a parallel DNS-tunnel channel that hex-encodes the JSON payload and splits it into <=60-char subdomain labels resolved against the callback domain. The package name pattern and version (999.9.10) are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe: any environment that resolves this name from the public registry will beacon its identity to the author-controlled callback.
